raw_segments.text: Besides, how many women of this description pass their days, or at least their evenings
Their husbands acknowledge that they are good managers and chaste wives, but leave home
May I be allowed to use a significant French word, Pequent Society, and the patient drudge
who fulfills her task, like a blind horse in a mill, is defrauded of her just reward,
for the wages due to her are the caresses of her husband, and women who have so few
resources in themselves do not very patiently bear this privation of a natural right.
